businessModel.primary: owned local media and audience distribution
revenueSequence: ads and local sponsorships after audience fit is proven

audience.buyer: people who live, work, commute, eat, and make plans in the Lower Mainland
audience.pain: useful local changes are scattered across city sites, transit notices, event calendars, teams, and business announcements
audience.promise: a fast, sourced view of what changed around the Lower Mainland and what residents should know or do next

editorialWedge.positioning: the useful daily briefing for Vancouver and the Lower Mainland
editorialWedge.mechanism: scan primary local sources throughout the day, publish concise verified updates, and earn a repeat-reading habit through practical regional coverage

beats.readerJob: tell me what changed in my city and whether it affects me
tell me about disruptions, road changes, transit service, weather, and travel impacts
help me find timely events and make plans around the region
tell me which restaurants and local businesses are opening, closing, or worth knowing about
explain development, rent, and housing changes that affect Lower Mainland residents
give me the useful local sports update without filler

constraint.statement: Trends Today has broad evergreen inventory but no clear reason for a Lower Mainland reader to return several times a week.
constraint.avoidedHardAction: commit the publication to one geography and build a real daily local reporting rhythm

portfolio.purpose: fresh service, civic, weather, transit, opening, and event updates
events, food, and guides that help residents make plans
housing, development, cost, and policy explainers with local context
durable neighbourhood, transportation, and local-service search demand

experiment.changedVariable: a Lower Mainland daily-news focus instead of broad national technology and science coverage
leadingMetrics: local search impressions after 7 and 28 days
guardrails: every story names its Lower Mainland locality and practical reader impact
every story meets its source threshold and includes a primary source
no publication without an exact-candidate independent review, deterministic validation, passing deployment checks, and live verification
no public app promotion without an attributable CTA
experiment.reviewCadence: weekly operating review; 28-day keep, repair, or stop decision per beat
